data.text:
Deepak Shrivastava vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 22
January, 2024 
Author: Anand Pathak
Bench: Anand Pathak
 1
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
 Before
 HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE ANAND PATHAK  ON THE 22 nd OF JANUARY, 2024  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 56751 of 2023 BETWEEN:- 
DEEPAK SHRIVASTAVA S/O LATE SHRI GORISHANKAR SHRIVASTAVA, AGED ABOUT 40 YEARS, OCCUPATION: 
PRIVATE JOB TULSI COLONY BEHIND JAIL MORENA TEHSIL AND DISTRICT MORENA (MADHYA PRADESH)
 .....APPLICANT (BY SHRI RAJEEV SHRIVASTAVA - ADVOCATE ) 
AND THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH INCHARGE POLICE STATION THROUGH POLICE STATION S.T.F. BHOPAL (MADHYA PRADESH)
 .....RESPONDENTS (BY SHRI RAVINDRA SINGH KUSHWAH - DY.A.G. ) 
 This application coming on for admission this day, the court passed the following:
 ORDER 1 . T he applicant has filed this third application under Section 439 of Code o f Criminal Procedure for grant of bail. Applicant has been arrested on 22.09.2023 by Police Station STF Bhopal, relating to Crime No.11/2019 for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 272, 273, 120-B of IPC and Section 51, 59 of Food Safety & Standard Act, 2006. 
2. It is the submission of learned counsel for applicant that it is a case of bail jump and applicant is suffering confinement since 22.09.2023 and suffered more than four months of incarceration. 
Earlier he suffered around one month as pretrial detention. Therefore, he already suffered sufficient period of incarceration. Because of medical condition of his daughter on the fateful day he could not appear before the trial Court and arrest warrant has been issued against him. Now he learnt the lesson hardway and would mend his ways to become better citizen. He is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions as may be imposed by this Court. Upon these grounds, counsel prayed for Deepak Shrivastava vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 22 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/73467654/
1 grant of bail.
3 . Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer and prayed for dismissal of application. 
4 . Heard learned counsel for the parties at length and perused the case diary.
5 . Considering the above submissions and the reason for absence, but without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court intends to allow this application but with certain stringent conditions. 
Accordingly, the application is allowed. It is hereby directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court/CJM, Gwalior. 
6. This order will remain operative subject to compliance of the following conditions by the applicant :-
(i) The applicant will comply with all the terms and conditions of the bond executed by him;
(ii) The applicant will co-operate in the investigation/trial, as the case may be;
(iii) The applicant will not indulge himself in extending inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to the Police Officer, as the case may be;
(iv) The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence, of which he is accused;
(v) The applicant will not seek unnecessary adjournments during the trial;
(vi) The applicant will not leave India without previous permission of the trial Court/Investigating Officer, as the case may be;
(vii) The applicant shall mark his presence on 1st and 15th day of every month (in case of any holiday then immediately on next day) before the concerned police station between 10.30 am to 2.30 pm, till conclusion of trial.
7. Application stands allowed and disposed of. 
8. A copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance and information. 
9. Certified Copy as per rules. 
(ANAND PATHAK) JUDGE Van VANDANA VERMA 2024.01.22 18:38:39 +05'30'
